top_findings.title: Unguarded 2-letter suffix strip makes 'Santa Fe' queries return Santa Cruz matches
top_findings.evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/TeamNameNormalizer.cs:78-79 BareTrailingStateRegex '\s+[A-Za-z]{2}$' strips any trailing 2-letter token without checking StateCodes. Verified by compiling the shipped normalizer in a temp copy: NormalizeTeam('Ind. Santa Fe')='ind. santa', NormalizeTeam('Santa Fe' as query)='santa', so TeamMatches('Santa Cruz','Santa Fe')=True. 'Ind. Santa Fe' appears in 52 rows of data/kaggle/Libertadores_Matches.csv.
top_findings.suggestion: Only strip the trailing token when it is a member of the already-declared StateCodes set.
